question: Can a credential-free, locally-served ASYMMETRIC-DISCOVERY task bank (ADB-v6) be certified ARITHMETICALLY in DESIGN before freeze - the cold re-derivation baseline (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE) and the retrieval-shaped comparator (B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED) provably below ceiling (point < 0.95 AND two-sided 95% Wilson high < the session-amortizing treatment's low) on the high-novelty stratum, the treatment (T-AMORT-REUSE) behaviourally distinct and live, a foreknown-schema positive control (PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA) solvable, all four mandate counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) reconciling exactly to the server, and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate CALIBRATED against a same-transport known-degenerate calibration class (CC-DEGENERATE) so that the certificate demonstrably returns FALSE on a class whose comparators sit at the correctness ceiling - and be delivered as a reusable Runtime substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (blocker B2)? This is explicitly an instrument/certificate experiment, NOT a re-run of the deterministic mandatory-discovery REST class already shown degenerate (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064: cold/retrieval success 1.0/1.0). If the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate class tested, DESIGN records a bounded substrate-class negative and does NOT freeze.
hypothesis: A credential-free deterministic localhost REST bank is a certified non-degenerate instrument for the flagship inheritance benchmark iff its discovery structure is a session-scoped CARRY CHAIN such that (a) each session begins with a fixed bootstrap (root, hub, boot/1..5 = 7 requests; /boot/5 serves the session manifest with the ordered role registry R1..R6 and the task list) and each required role is resolved by a fixed 3-step chained protocol GET /disc/<role>/<step> where each step requires the previous step's value, so no policy can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests per task without persisting the resolved token across tasks; (b) the hidden-role count grows with novelty as h(n)=8n for n in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75}; (c) the task specification is handed to every arm as the task input (uniformly, not an HTTP request); (d) the published per-task integer request budget B(n)={11,15,16,18} is non-decreasing and lenient; and (e) the same certificate predicate is calibrated against a same-transport calibration class CC-DEGENERATE whose discovery is QUERY-ANSWERABLE (1 request per role, no carry) and whose budget B_deg(n)={11,13,15,17} is deliberately generous. Under these frozen declarations the arithmetic predicts: on the asymmetric class ADB-v6, cold cost 3h+8={8,14,20,26} and retrieval total (server 3h+6 plus 3 local index probes) ={9,15,21,27} exceed B(n) at high novelty (n>=0.5) while treatment per-task http {9,7,7,7} and PC h+8={8,10,12,14} fit every level, giving high-novelty success cold 0/12, retrieval 0/12, treatment 12/12, PC 12/12 with non-overlapping Wilson intervals (comparator k<=6 high <= 0.7462 < treatment lo 0.7575); on the degenerate calibration class CC-DEGENERATE cold h+8={8,10,12,14} and retrieval total {9,11,13,15} fit B_deg(n) at every level, so both comparators reach the ceiling and the SAME certificate predicate returns FALSE; the certificate therefore has observable dynamic range rather than being a constant-TRUE oracle. If the carry-chain asymmetric construction does NOT produce this separation on the credential-free class, the flagship benchmark must not be funded on this bank class.
falsifier: The ADB-v6 bank-readiness hypothesis is falsified or bounded by any of: (F1) on the asymmetric class ADB-v6 at least one comparator (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE or B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED) reaches the ceiling or its high-novelty Wilson 95% interval is not disjoint below the treatment's (observed point >= 0.95, or interval overlap, e.g. comparator high-novelty k >= 7 of 12) while PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA succeeds and every integrity gate holds - the bank has no certified dynamic range; (F2) the DESIGN arithmetic certificate shows a high-novelty stratum empty, a predicted success cell unreachable, or a budget that admits a comparator at high novelty (caught before freeze, not a runtime discovery); (F3) the treatment is not live at HIGH novelty - it fails a high-novelty task, or its per-task cost exceeds B(n), or the observed comparator-minus-treatment total gap is not non-decreasing across n or its high-novelty minimum is < 8 requests (a treatment failure at LOW novelty n<0.5, or a session whose declared sequence is not the frozen ascending warm-up, is integrity gate I9 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, an instrument failure, not a scientific negative); (F4) any integrity gate fails - PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA < 24/24, a low-novelty treatment failure, an out-of-support session accepted, a budget-truncation overrun, counter reconciliation non-zero, session replay not exact, rendered declaration/certificate not equal to the embedded declaration/predicted certificate, a route-token leak, a non-deterministic re-run, a contamination failure, or (F5) the CC-DEGENERATE calibration gate I11 fails (a CC-DEGENERATE comparator does NOT reach the ceiling), which means the certificate's FALSE prediction is miscalibrated. F1/F3 map to status=COMPLETE with outcome FALSIFIES or MIXED (a bounded negative about this bank construction). F4/F5 map to status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (instrument/calibration failure), never a scientific negative. F2 is a DESIGN/freeze failure, not a result. If the certificate is unsatisfiable on every class tested, DESIGN records a bounded substrate-class negative and does not freeze.

B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.role: strong baseline (first agent, no cross-task inheritance, per-task isolation)
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.description: Stateless per-task episode with no cross-task memory, no retrieval index, no mechanism store and no session state; handed the site root only. It may use any site-native enumeration channel (robots.txt, sitemap.xml) at zero additional cost, but the declared sitemap lists only /, /hub and /about, so enumeration cannot amortize the boot chain or the session manifest. It walks the bootstrap (root -> hub -> boot/1..5 = 7 requests; /boot/5 serves the session manifest), then, because the discovery protocol is carry-chained and it cannot persist a resolved role across a task, re-walks the full 3-step chain for each required role (3h), then /verify (1). Per-task cost = 3h(n)+8 <= B(n) only at n in {0,0.25} (8,14) and strictly over budget at n in {0.5,0.75} (20,26).
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.procedure: fresh_episode -> bootstrap(root,hub,boot1..5,manifest_at_boot5) -> for each required role: disc(step1),disc(step2),disc(step3) -> verify
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.scope_bound: Deliberately non-omniscient and stateless: the strongest bounded planner given the same published budget as every arm (shortest bootstrap, full site-native enumeration), but forbidden from carrying a resolution receipt across tasks of a session. Because the discovery primitive is a fixed carry chain, no policy can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests per task without cross-task persistence - the exact capability under test. This experiment certifies the instrument under these declared policies; it does not claim these policies are optimal against an unrealized memory-carrying agent (readiness condition 3).

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.description: Like cold, plus it issues 3 local index probes per task against a cross-instance leave-instance-out trajectory index built only from OTHER sessions' trajectories (the probes are a local module call counted separately as retrieval_calls, not server http_requests). The index supplies only the static root/hub navigational prefix (so retrieval starts at /boot/1 and spends 5 bootstrap requests instead of 7), but because the boot-chain carries and the role-resolution receipts are session-scoped and the index is leave-instance-out, retrieved fragments cannot supply the current session's carries or role mapping; retrieval still re-walks the full 3-step chain per role per task (3h). Server cost = 3h(n)+6; total including the 3 index probes = 3h(n)+9; it clears B(n) only at n in {0,0.25} (6,12) and is strictly over budget at n in {0.5,0.75} (18,24). The index cost is included in every total, so the comparison never omits a cost dimension the comparator actually pays.
B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.procedure: fresh_episode -> index_top_k(3, leave_instance_out) -> bootstrap(boot1..5,manifest_at_boot5) -> for each required role: disc(step1),disc(step2),disc(step3) -> verify
B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.scope_bound: The index is cross-instance and leave-instance-out; a retrieval advantage would require the index to supply the current session's carries or role mapping, which it cannot, so retrieval's headroom is bounded by the fixed 2-request navigational prefix. If retrieval nonetheless reaches the high-novelty ceiling or overlaps the treatment interval, the design is falsified (F1), not rescued. A retrieval policy that additionally persists a within-session mechanism store would blur into T-AMORT-REUSE and is out of scope by construction. Declared limitation: because retrieval saves only the fixed 2-request root/hub prefix over cold, its stratum-level success profile coincides with cold (both {T,T,F,F}); the two comparators therefore jointly bracket the ceiling rather than testing independent mechanisms. Both are strictly below the treatment and their ledgers differ (retrieval pays 3 index probes and 1 fewer server request).

treatment.role: session-amortizing mechanism (the Runtime substrate capability under test; declared stand-in for the unshipped Product B1 carrier C-PARAM-INHERIT)
treatment.description: A stateful policy that opens one multi-task session, walks the carry-chained bootstrap once (root, hub, boot/1..5 = 7 requests) and fetches /tasks (1) = 8 session requests charged to the warm-up task, then resolves the session's tasks in the frozen ascending sequence. The task specification is handed to every arm as the task input and is not an HTTP request for any arm (uniform across arms). It persists the session manifest and, after a role's 3-step /disc chain completes, records that role's resolved token; on later tasks an already-known role costs 0 /disc requests and each newly introduced role costs 3 (roles are nested: level n introduces the first h(n)=8n roles, so 2 new roles per escalating level). It issues /verify (1 per task). Per-task http = [9,7,7,7] for n=0/0.25/0.5/0.75; session total 30; every per-task cost <= B(n). Before spending, it validates that the manifest declares the frozen ascending warm-up sequence ['0.0','0.25','0.5','0.75']; if the sequence differs it refuses the session (UNKNOWN, no commit, no verify) rather than overspending.
treatment.procedure: open_session -> validate_manifest_sequence -> bootstrap(root,hub,boot1..5) -> tasks -> spec1 -> [task_k: (spec if k>1) + new_roles*3 + verify]
treatment.scope_bound: The treatment is a declared deterministic Runtime mechanism, not a Product carrier, so the pre-freeze Product-carrier liveness mandate does not apply; its liveness is structural and certified arithmetically (every per-task cost <= B(n) under the declared session schema, and it refuses rather than overspends on any non-conforming sequence). This instrument does not itself establish the inheritance economics; that is the downstream four-arm benchmark (dependencies C-PARAM-INHERIT and C-LLM-INHERIT are referenced, not tested here).

positive_control.description: A policy given the session manifest, the role registry and the resolved role tokens out of band (zero discovery cost) on the SAME 24 test tasks (all 4 novelty levels, so the full 4-arm x 4-level success matrix is measured and P6 is evaluable), plus the task spec. It walks the bootstrap (7) and issues one commit per required role (h) + /verify (1) = h(n)+8 = {8,10,12,14}, all <= B(n). If the bank is realizable and budgets adequate this must succeed 24/24; failure at any level means the bank is unsolvable and separates 'no headroom because discovery is costly' from 'no headroom because the task is impossible'. It is a SOLVABILITY ceiling control, NOT a headroom comparator, and is excluded from the comparator-minus-treatment gap computation.
positive_control.expected_behavior: success_in_budget = 24/24 across all novelty levels; high-novelty stratum 12/12

null_control.description: Five frozen out-of-support session instances whose manifest schema is not the frozen schema (non-ascending task sequence or a role registry that is not the nested first-h(n) draw). T-AMORT-REUSE must classify at the manifest/hub step and refuse (UNKNOWN, no commit, no verify) rather than fabricate or fall through to a generic resolver. This checks that treatment success is session/schema-bound and not a substrate artifact.
null_control.expected_behavior: refusal_rate = 1.0, false_accepts = 0/5, bound_value = null; refusal observed after at most 2 requests (root, hub)
null_control.frozen_null_requirement: 5 frozen out-of-support session instances, all refused with reason OUT_OF_SUPPORT at the manifest classification step

additional_controls.CC-DEGENERATE: CERTIFICATE-SENSITIVITY calibration class (new in ADB-v6): the SAME localhost transport with a QUERY-ANSWERABLE discovery route GET /answer/<role> (1 request per role, no carry chain) and budget B_deg(n)={11,13,15,17}. Both strong comparators (cold h+8={8,10,12,14}; retrieval total {9,11,13,15}) are predicted to fit B_deg at every level and therefore to reach the ceiling. The frozen certificate predicate must return FALSE for CC-DEGENERATE while returning TRUE for ADB-v6; if either CC-DEGENERATE comparator is observed BELOW the ceiling the certificate calibration has failed (gate I11 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). This is the control that proves the certificate is not a constant-TRUE oracle and directly encodes the Director mandate's 'unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested' branch.
additional_controls.NC-BUDGET-TRUNCATION: 6 deliberately under-funded episodes: all must stop at the imposed budget with zero overrun and a recorded failure/partial state (gate I3).
additional_controls.M-COUNTER-RECONCILE: per-episode arm counters must equal the server request log and subset relations must hold; mismatches must be 0 (gate I4).
additional_controls.M-REPAIR-TRANSIENT: one injected transient fault per episode: observed repair_attempts is 1 (charged to http_requests) or an honest failure; no hidden retry.
additional_controls.PC-EXACT-SESSION-REPLAY: 6 replayed treatment test sessions reproduce the original per-route counter vectors exactly (gate I5).

substrate.name: ADB-v6 (Asymmetric-Discovery Bank, v6) with calibration class CC-DEGENERATE
substrate.type: credential-free, locally-served, deterministic multi-page REST substrate with a session-scoped carry-chained role-resolution layer, plus a same-transport query-answerable calibration sibling
substrate.implementation: Python 3.12 standard library only: http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer for the site, urllib.request for arm transport, html.parser + json for parsing, hashlib for content digests, random.Random(SEED) for seeded values. No third-party package, no browser, no external network, no credentials, no cookies, no model calls. The site and arms import no pre-existing Runtime module.
substrate.transport: http on 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral OS-chosen port; the port is not part of the frozen declaration identity (declared as the literal string 'ephemeral-not-frozen').

measurement_validity.discovery_protocol: Asymmetric class ADB-v6: per role, resolution is a fixed 3-step carry chain: GET /disc/<role>/1 returns a per-role session nonce N_r; GET /disc/<role>/2/<N_r> returns a partial token P_r iff N_r is the session-valid nonce; GET /disc/<role>/3/<P_r> returns the resolved token T_r and commits role r for the session iff P_r is valid. Each step requires the previous step's value and the chain mixes the role id with the session secret, so it cannot be shortened or shared across roles within a task, and no arm can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests without persisting T_r across tasks. This makes the per-role cost strategy-invariant. Calibration class CC-DEGENERATE: per role, resolution is a single GET /answer/<role> returning T_r directly (query-answerable, 1 request), so a stateless arm can satisfy the budget without persistence.

task_bank.construction: F=2 families (F1,F2), 3 test sessions per family x 4 tasks (one per novelty level n in {0.0,0.25,0.5,0.75}) = 24 test tasks per arm for ADB-v6; high-novelty stratum n>=0.5 = 12 tasks per arm, low-novelty = 12. Each session's task list is fixed ascending ['0.0','0.25','0.5','0.75'] and each task requires the first h(n)=8n of the session's ordered registry R1..R6 (0,2,4,6 roles). The task spec exposes role names but MUST NOT contain any route token (session id, canonical base, boot/hub/task/disc routes or absolute URLs). The CC-DEGENERATE calibration bank is a single family x 4 high-novelty tasks (n in {0.5,0.75}, 4 tasks) evaluated by both comparators; it is a certificate-calibration control, not a headroom comparator.
task_bank.novelty_definition: novelty n is a declared level of each frozen task; high novelty is n>=0.5, low novelty n<0.5. The h(n)=8n hidden-role count is the operational cost driver, so stratum membership is arithmetic, not EXECUTE discretion.
task_bank.budget_semantics: Per-task integer HTTP-request budget applied identically to every arm. Success = every required role is committed and /verify confirms the committed state within B(n) server requests. ADB-v6 budgets are non-decreasing and deliberately LENIENT toward the comparators (they do not shrink with novelty), so a comparator failing at high novelty fails despite the allowance. CC-DEGENERATE budgets are deliberately generous so that both comparators are forced to the ceiling, making certificate FALSE the correct prediction.
task_bank.route_leak_rule: For every rendered task spec, disc page, hub, boot page and sitemap, the text must contain no absolute URL and none of the literals '/s/', '{sid}', '/boot/', '/hub', '/tasks', '/disc/', '/answer/', '/verify', or the session id; only the arm's own navigational relative links are permitted. The sitemap may list only '/', '/hub' and '/about'. Checked statically in DESIGN and re-checked at EXECUTE (gate I7).

per_task_counters.http_requests: server-logged HTTP request count for the episode (ground truth); includes bootstrap, discovery and verify
per_task_counters.bootstrap_requests: subset of http_requests spent on root/hub/boot navigation
per_task_counters.discovery_calls: subset of http_requests spent on the discovery protocol (3h for stateless arms on ADB-v6; new_roles*3 for the treatment; h for stateless arms on CC-DEGENERATE)
per_task_counters.retrieval_calls: local index queries issued (0 for cold/treatment; 3 per task for retrieval) - counted separately from http_requests because the index is an in-process module, and disclosed as such
per_task_counters.repair_attempts: recovery actions issued after a failed discovery/verify, capped at 1 per task; each is charged to http_requests and recorded
per_task_counters.excluded: latency_ms and model calls/tokens are prohibited as decision inputs (prior audit found latency_ms/1000 to be instrument noise)

measurement_validity.authorship_separation: The site (ground-truth provider and request-log authority) and the arm policies are separate modules; the site never imports an arm module and no arm may read the site source. The retrieval index is built by a module that cannot read the site source or the evaluated session/family.
measurement_validity.counter_honesty: Every arm-reported counter must reconcile exactly to the site request log. Per episode the frozen predicate is: arm_reported_http_requests == server_logged_requests AND bootstrap_requests + discovery_calls + verification_calls <= http_requests AND retrieval_calls and repair_attempts are recorded independently of http_requests (bootstrap_requests and discovery_calls are subsets, never summed with http_requests). M-COUNTER-RECONCILE mismatches must be 0 or the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.determinism: All topology, listing order, role ordering, disc values and task banks are generated from the frozen declaration and seed. The EXECUTE-rendered site's canonical topology object (serialized with json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) ) must equal the declaration embedded verbatim in prereg.md section 5, and the recomputed predicted certificate must equal the certificate embedded in prereg.md section 6 (gate I6). Running the same episode twice must produce identical counters (gate I8). DESIGN-computed informational cross-check digests (non-binding; I6 is structural equality) are recorded in prereg.md section 6. Additionally, EXECUTE must write research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-38087588064/bank_manifest.json containing a canonical digest of the fully-rendered bank (ordered role registry, role-to-token mapping, task payloads, route strings), hash-recorded in provenance.json/result.json.artifacts; this extends, without loosening, gate I6 beyond the topology object so the concrete rendered bank instance is bound post-hoc.
measurement_validity.inference_scope: The ADB-v6 task population is a small deterministic finite bank (24 tasks; 12 per novelty stratum), not a random sample from a population. The Wilson intervals are descriptive summaries over these fixed tasks and are NOT sampling-based confidence intervals; the matched-task design makes the treatment/comparator contrast deterministic given a faithful render. They are used only as the frozen, pre-declared separation criterion (comparator interval disjoint below the treatment interval), not as an inferential population claim.
measurement_validity.prerequisites: Python 3.12 standard library present (http.server, urllib.request, html.parser, json, hashlib, random, statistics, socket, threading); no browser, no network egress, no credential and no external dataset. A DESIGN stdlib import probe (python 3.12.15, 9 modules) and a localhost ThreadingHTTPServer canary (127.0.0.1:ephemeral, HTTP 200) confirmed both prerequisites. The bank is not an external prerequisite: it is the object under certification, fully specified by the frozen declaration in prereg.md and materialized at EXECUTE inside the experiment transaction; its identity is checked by gate I6.
measurement_validity.no_synthetic_fallback: Any failure (site bind failure, transport error, digest mismatch) is recorded with the exact error and mapped to MEASUREMENT_INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE, never silently substituted and never encoded as a scientific negative.
measurement_validity.site_authoring_disclosure: The substrate is synthetic by design (no third-party site exhibits exactly this declared asymmetric structure). This experiment certifies the INSTRUMENT's dynamic range and honesty under declared non-omniscient policies; it does not certify transfer to the open Web or to a real LLM agent (see validity threats).
measurement_validity.memory_asymmetry_disclosure: The declared asymmetry between arms is a within-session MEMORY asymmetry, stated openly rather than hidden behind a protocol trick. The discovery protocol is a fixed 3-step carry chain that no policy can shorten; the only way to pay less than 3 per role per task is to persist the resolved token across tasks, which is exactly the declared treatment capability. B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED are declared as the strongest bounded policies consistent with their no-cross-task-persistence constraint (shortest bootstrap, full site-native enumeration, retrieval's full leave-instance-out index). This experiment certifies the instrument under exactly these declared policies; it explicitly does NOT claim a memory-carrying LLM agent (readiness condition 3) is bounded by them.
measurement_validity.pre2_discipline: Screened against codex/legacy_brief.json: no pre-2.0 asymmetric-discovery / certified-dynamic-range task-bank precedent exists (LEGACY: NO_MATCH for the bank construction). The nearest legacy lesson, P2-REPLAY-COST (source sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b: the withdrawn 8.5x claim rested on matched tasks with fully loaded counterfactuals), is applied as a guard: every arm pays fully loaded costs including retrieval probes and repair charges, tasks are matched across arms, and no scripted-replay economics is claimed. LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION - the certification target (arithmetic pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate for a session-scoped asymmetric-discovery bank, CALIBRATED against a same-transport degenerate sibling) has no pre-2.0 analogue and also materially differs from the immediately preceding ADB-v5 design (EXP-RUNTIME-38085184570) by adding the CC-DEGENERATE certificate-sensitivity calibration and its gate I11, and from ADB-v1 (EXP-RUNTIME-38051419597) by removing the strategy-dependent discovery policy.

contamination_certificate.isolation: Each arm runs against a fresh server process on a fresh ephemeral port with a fresh in-memory session namespace; no arm shares mutable state with another and server request logs are per-arm.
contamination_certificate.index_isolation: The retrieval index is built only from OTHER sessions' trajectories (leave-instance-out) and MUST NOT contain any route, token or page from the evaluated session or family.
contamination_certificate.route_leak: No task spec, disc page, hub, boot page or sitemap contains a session id, an absolute URL or any declared route literal (gate I7).
contamination_certificate.signature_disjointness: Arms' route-trace signatures must be disjoint apart from the declared shared navigational routes (root/hub/boot/verify); any undeclared overlap is contamination (gate I10).
contamination_falsifiers: any route token appears in a rendered spec/page (I7) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID
the retrieval index contains an evaluated-session/family item (I10) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID
cross-arm request-log overlap beyond the declared navigational routes (I10) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID
a comparator success at high novelty / interval overlap (P1/P2) -> FALSIFIES

measurement_validity.reusable_substrate_delivery: EXECUTE materialises the generator and harness as research/runtime/adb_v6_bank.py and research/runtime/adb_v6_harness.py (within the Runtime lane's authorized code root) plus a frozen bank manifest at research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-38087588064/bank_manifest.json, and records their sha256 in provenance.json, so downstream Runtime/Product work can bind the bank as a reusable substrate (blocker B2). Freeze-time hashing is not applicable because the deliverable does not pre-exist freeze.

frozen_thresholds.interval_disjointness: each comparator's high-novelty Wilson 95% upper bound must be strictly below the treatment's high-novelty Wilson 95% lower bound (with n=12 the boundary is comparator k<=6: hi 0.746218 < treatment lo 0.757506; k>=7 gives hi 0.806740 and fails)

integrity_gates.I1: PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA succeeds 24/24 overall and 12/12 on the high-novelty stratum (bank solvable).
integrity_gates.I2: NC-OOS-SCHEMA false_accepts = 0/5 and all 5 refusals observed at manifest classification.
integrity_gates.I3: NC-BUDGET-TRUNCATION: all 6 truncated episodes stop at the imposed budget with zero overrun and a recorded failure/partial state.
integrity_gates.I4: M-COUNTER-RECONCILE mismatches = 0 (arm counters == site request log; per-condition and total ledgers reconcile; subset relations hold).
integrity_gates.I5: PC-EXACT-SESSION-REPLAY: the 6 replayed treatment test sessions reproduce the original per-route counter vectors exactly.
integrity_gates.I6: Render equality: EXECUTE-rendered canonical declaration object == the declaration embedded in prereg.md section 5, AND recomputed predicted certificate == the certificate embedded in prereg.md section 6.
integrity_gates.I7: Route-token leak absent on every rendered spec/disc/answer/hub/boot/task page and the sitemap lists only /, /hub and /about.
integrity_gates.I8: Determinism: a repeated episode produces byte-identical counters.
integrity_gates.I9: Treatment session-schema and low-novelty liveness abort gate: T-AMORT-REUSE validates the frozen ascending warm-up sequence, refuses (UNKNOWN, no overspend) on any non-conforming session, and succeeds on every n<0.5 task with per-task cost <= B(n). A structural treatment failure here is an instrument failure, not a scientific negative.
integrity_gates.I10: Contamination gate: per-arm server isolation holds, the retrieval index is leave-instance-out (no evaluated-session/family item), and arm route-trace signatures are disjoint in all instance-scoped content (session ids, nonces, partial/resolved role tokens and per-session payloads). Declared shared route TEMPLATES (root, hub, boot/1..5, /disc/<role>/1..3, /answer/<role>, /verify) are EXPECTED to be issued by more than one arm and never count as contamination; the retrieval index may contain navigational templates but no evaluated-session/family instance content.
integrity_gates.I11: Certificate-sensitivity calibration gate: on CC-DEGENERATE both B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED reach the ceiling (high-novelty point >= 0.95), so the frozen certificate legitimately returns TRUE for ADB-v6 and FALSE for CC-DEGENERATE. A CC-DEGENERATE comparator below the ceiling means the certificate's FALSE prediction is miscalibrated -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

propositions.P1: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE high-novelty success point < 0.95 AND Wilson 95% hi < treatment Wilson 95% lo (non-overlapping intervals; predicted k=0/12, hi 0.242494).
propositions.P2: B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED high-novelty success point < 0.95 AND Wilson 95% hi < treatment Wilson 95% lo (predicted k=0/12, hi 0.242494).
propositions.P3: T-AMORT-REUSE succeeds 12/12 at high novelty (point 1.0, Wilson lo 0.757506 >= 0.75) AND 12/12 at low novelty (per-task cost <= B(n)).
propositions.P4: Observed per-task mean comparator-minus-treatment total-request gap is non-decreasing across n=0,0.25,0.5,0.75 for BOTH comparators AND strictly increasing across the two high-novelty levels (0.5 < 0.75).
propositions.P5: Minimum observed high-novelty per-task mean gap >= 8 requests (predicted 13 cold / 14 retrieval).
propositions.P6: Exact certificate agreement: the observed 4-arm x 4-level ADB-v6 success matrix equals the predicted matrix and the observed per-condition request ledger equals the predicted ledger (prereg.md section 6).
propositions.P7: Certificate discrimination: the frozen certificate predicate evaluated on the embedded declaration returns CERT=TRUE for ADB-v6 and CERT=FALSE for CC-DEGENERATE, and this is confirmed observationally by the CC-DEGENERATE comparators reaching the ceiling (I11) while the ADB-v6 comparators do not (P1/P2).

result_mapping.precedence: Ordered precedence: (0) if bring-up, site bind, transport or digest infrastructure fails so that one or more gates cannot be evaluated, the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE and is never reported as MEASUREMENT_INVALID or as a scientific negative; (1) otherwise evaluate integrity gates I1..I11 first - any gate that was evaluable and FAILED gives MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (2) with the integrity set holding, SUPPORTS iff P1..P7 all hold; else FALSIFIES iff NOT (P1 AND P2); else MIXED. Because MIXED is defined as P1 AND P2 AND NOT(P1 AND P2 AND P3 AND P4 AND P5 AND P6 AND P7), SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES and MIXED are disjoint and cover every integrity-passing case: the precedence is a total partition, and the infrastructure case (0) is disjoint from all of them.
result_mapping.SUPPORTS: Integrity set holds AND P1..P7. A bank with certified cold/retrieval headroom under the declared policies, a live amortizing mechanism with non-overlapping high-novelty intervals, honest reconciled counters over the four mandate counters, a certificate demonstrated to discriminate (TRUE on the asymmetric class, FALSE on the same-transport degenerate sibling), and no route leak or contamination. C-MEAS-VALID's construct boundary widens, within its bounded scope, to include 'measurement-valid substrate with a certified non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery bank' for Runtime-owned downstream work.
result_mapping.FALSIFIES: Integrity set holds AND at least one comparator reaches the ceiling or its high-novelty interval is not disjoint below the treatment's (NOT (P1 AND P2)). A bounded negative about this declared asymmetric-discovery construction. status=COMPLETE.
result_mapping.MIXED: Integrity set holds AND P1 AND P2 AND NOT (P1 AND P2 AND P3 AND P4 AND P5 AND P6 AND P7) - the comparator separation holds but at least one of P3 (treatment liveness), P4/P5 (gap trend/magnitude), P6 (exact certificate agreement) or P7 (certificate discrimination) does not. Localizes whether the headroom is real while the declared mechanism/cost model/certificate calibration is wrong. status=COMPLETE.
result_mapping.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Any integrity-gate failure I1..I11 (including the low-novelty treatment liveness / session-schema abort gate I9, the contamination gate I10 and the certificate-sensitivity calibration gate I11). The measurement did not validly probe the claim; instrument failure, never a scientific negative; repair and re-run rather than reinterpreting.
result_mapping.INCONCLUSIVE: Substrate bring-up, site bind, transport or digest-infrastructure failure prevents completing the matrix; recorded with the smallest unblocking action. Never a scientific negative.

arithmetic_certificate.computed_in: DESIGN by a non-outcome-bearing stdlib probe (python 3.12.15); no arm was run and no success was measured.

calibration_class_cc_degenerate.discovery: 1 request per role (query-answerable, no carry chain)

arithmetic_certificate.certificate_predicate: CERT(cls) = TRUE iff (a) every strong baseline's predicted minimum total cost at high novelty (n>=0.5) strictly exceeds B(n), (b) the treatment's predicted maximum per-task cost <= B(n) at every level, and (c) the positive control's predicted per-task cost <= B(n) at every level. CERT(ADB-v6)=TRUE; CERT(CC-DEGENERATE)=FALSE because cold 12<=15 and 14<=17 (comparators not below ceiling).

reachability_certificate.SUPPORTS: Reachable: a faithful render of the declaration yields the predicted matrices and ledger (ADB-v6 comparator k=0, treatment k=12, disjoint intervals; CC-DEGENERATE comparators k=4/4 at ceiling). Note the honest nature of a certification experiment: under a byte-faithful render SUPPORTS is expected by construction; the empirical content is that the render matches the declaration and the controls behave, including the certificate sensitivity.
reachability_certificate.FALSIFIES: Reachable under an integrity-passing render (I1..I11 all hold) whenever an observed ADB-v6 comparator high-novelty success reaches k>=7 of 12 (hi 0.806740 >= treatment lo 0.757506, intervals overlap) or point >= 0.95, while PC reaches 24/24. Because success is observed per episode rather than logically forced by the frozen declaration, a render that passes I6 (which pins the declared topology object, not every behavioural realization) can still leak a shortcut - e.g. an accidentally short /disc chain, an off-by-one budget check, or a task that admits a shorter carry path - letting a comparator fit B(n) at high novelty. This is the decision-changing scientific negative branch.
reachability_certificate.MIXED: Reachable under a faithful render: a cost-model-only divergence (e.g. the treatment session pays a different number of bootstrap or spec requests, or a different per-level gap pattern) changes the observed ledger/gaps (NOT P6/P4/P5) without flipping the high-novelty separation (P1,P2,P3 hold).
reachability_certificate.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Reachable: any of I1..I11 (e.g. a route leak, counter mismatch, replay mismatch, declaration/certificate mismatch, contamination, a low-novelty treatment failure / non-conforming session, or a CC-DEGENERATE comparator below the ceiling).
reachability_certificate.INCONCLUSIVE: Reachable: localhost bind or transport failure before episode execution.

product_consequence_positive: If SUPPORTS, Runtime hands downstream lanes (Graph C-FRESHNESS/C-DELTA-REPAIR and the Product four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark) a reusable, hash-recordable synthetic asymmetric-discovery task bank delivered at the Runtime lane root with certified comparator headroom UNDER THE DECLARED POLICIES, honest counters over the four mandate counters, and a certificate demonstrated to discriminate an asymmetric class from a same-transport degenerate sibling, so a later treatment advantage measured under those policies is no longer at risk of being an unreachable-margin or ceiling artifact. Scope-honest claim: this advances readiness condition (2) for this instrument by delivering a bank whose dynamic range is certified for the declared stateless/amortizing policies; it does NOT certify dynamic range against a real memory-carrying LLM agent, which could erase the declared memory asymmetry, so blocker B2 is only partially retired pending readiness condition (3). C-MEAS-VALID widens only within its bounded instrument scope; this is not product promotion and not a Web-transfer claim.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIES, the session-amortized asymmetric-discovery construction does not create certified headroom on the credential-free localhost class either; the program must not fund the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark on this bank class and should change the discovery asymmetry (third-party/adversarial populations) or scope the benchmark to a real-agent-capable substrate once readiness condition (3) is met. If MIXED, the ceiling headroom is retained but the declared cost model/trend/certificate calibration must be corrected before reuse. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID, the instrument is repaired before any downstream spend. Every failure is bounded to this construction, not to C-MEAS-VALID's parent VALIDATED ceiling.

estimated_cost.substrate: local stdlib HTTP server; no network egress, no browser, no model calls, no credentials
estimated_cost.cost_note: Cheap by construction: all episodes are local HTTP with the stdlib. The expensive pre-freeze part (the arithmetic certificate and its calibration) is computed in DESIGN at zero runtime cost.

expected_information_gain: Moderate-to-high and instrument-scoped. The arithmetic certificate is a design guarantee conditional on the declared topology; once EXECUTE implements the declaration, SUPPORTS is largely the declaration taking effect, so the genuinely falsifiable pathways are implementation divergence, route/index leakage, counter dishonesty, budget-truncation behaviour, out-of-support false acceptance, contamination, and any arm behaviour that differs from the arithmetic (which fires MIXED or FALSIFIES). ADB-v6 adds a genuinely falsifiable certificate-sensitivity prediction over the immediately preceding ADB-v5 design: the SAME certificate predicate must return FALSE on a same-transport query-answerable class whose comparators reach the ceiling, so a constant-TRUE (uninformative) certificate is detectable rather than assumed. The experiment is decision-changing because it (a) tests whether the recurring 'dynamic-range certificate unsatisfiable / comparators at ceiling' defect is a declaration problem rather than an intrinsic impossibility on the credential-free class, (b) delivers a reusable bank with a calibrated comparator-headroom guarantee or a bounded negative at the Runtime lane root (blocker B2), and (c) explicitly closes the session-amortized asymmetric construction on FALSIFIES instead of re-discovering it in three lanes. It does NOT establish transfer to the open Web or to a real agent; that remains readiness condition (3).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The decision rule is pure arithmetic over planned n and the frozen declaration, computed before freeze with no outcomes (DESIGN probe). The accept region is non-empty and every verdict branch has a concrete reachable scenario: SUPPORTS (faithful render: ADB-v6 comparator k=0, treatment k=12, disjoint; CC-DEGENERATE comparator k=4/4 at ceiling), FALSIFIES (an integrity-passing render leaks a shortcut so an ADB-v6 comparator high-novelty k>=7 -> Wilson hi 0.806740 >= treatment lo 0.757506, intervals overlap, or point>=0.95), MIXED (cost-model/certificate-calibration divergence that preserves P1/P2 but breaks P6/P7), MEASUREMENT_INVALID (any I1..I11 failure), INCONCLUSIVE (bind/transport failure). Precedence is total and disjoint: integrity gate first (I1..I11), then SUPPORTS, then FALSIFIES = NOT(P1 AND P2), then MIXED = P1 AND P2 AND NOT(P1 AND P2 AND P3 AND P4 AND P5 AND P6 AND P7); no branch makes a later branch unreachable. Thresholds are attainable and demonstrated: at n=12, comparator k=0 gives point 0.0 and Wilson hi 0.242494 < treatment lo 0.757506 (SUPPORTS), while k=7 gives hi 0.806740 >= 0.757506 and k=12 gives point 1.0 >= 0.95 (FALSIFIES); treatment k=12 gives lo 0.757506 >= 0.75. The min high-novelty gap (13 cold / 14 retrieval) exceeds the >=8 threshold. Budgets B(n)={11,15,16,18} admit the treatment (9,7,7,7) and the positive control (8,10,12,14) at every level and reject both comparators at n>=0.5 (cold server cost 20,26; retrieval server cost 18,24; retrieval total including probes 21,27) while admitting both at n<0.5 (cold 8,14; retrieval server 6,12, total 9,15). CC-DEGENERATE budgets {11,13,15,17} admit cold (8,10,12,14) and retrieval total (9,11,13,15) at every level, so the certificate's FALSE prediction is arithmetically reachable too, making P7 and I11 decision-relevant rather than constant.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites are available now and were probed non-outcome-bearingly in DESIGN: (1) Python 3.12 standard library only (http.server, urllib.request, html.parser, json, hashlib, random, statistics, socket, threading) - a DESIGN import probe confirmed every required module (python 3.12.15, 9 modules), removing any browser/live-site/credential fragility; (2) a localhost ThreadingHTTPServer canary bound 127.0.0.1:ephemeral and returned HTTP 200, confirming transport. The bank is not an external prerequisite: it is the object under certification, fully declared in prereg.md and materialized at EXECUTE inside the experiment transaction with its identity checked by gate I6; no external site, dataset, credential or model endpoint is read. The retrieval index and the CC-DEGENERATE calibration sibling are in-transaction local modules derived from the same declaration, not external corpora. The DESIGN-stage write scope permits only spec.json/prereg.md, so the generator is necessarily an EXECUTE deliverable, but no unknown input affects the measurement: every quantity the decision depends on (h(n), budgets, arm costs, topology, strata, calibration budgets) is fixed in the frozen declaration.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and both strong baselines can differ on the frozen task population and are not guaranteed identical: comparator per-task costs exceed the published budgets at high novelty while the treatment fits every level, so the success profiles are provably distinct (ADB-v6 cold {T,T,F,F}, retrieval {T,T,F,F}, treatment {T,T,T,T}) and the high-novelty Wilson intervals are non-overlapping (comparator k=0 hi 0.242494 vs treatment lo 0.757506). Every cost dimension each comparator actually pays is charged: stateless arms pay per-task bootstrap AND the full 3-step discovery chain per required role; the retrieval arm is additionally charged its 3 local index probes (not omitted) and pays 2 fewer bootstrap requests, so its total is +1 vs cold; the treatment pays its session bootstrap once and pays discovery only for roles it has never resolved. Crucially the comparator costs are NOT policy artifacts: the discovery primitive is a fixed carry-chained 3-step protocol whose steps each require the previous step's value, so no strategy can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests per task without cross-task persistence - the exact capability under test. Route-trace signatures are formally distinct: retrieval = cold + {3 index probes}; treatment sessions contain /tasks once and one boot chain, and zero /disc on already-resolved roles; PC lacks the discovery chains; OOS refuses without commit. The CC-DEGENERATE class is a calibration control, not a headroom comparator, and is excluded from the ADB-v6 separation propositions. Declared limitation: retrieval saves only the fixed 2-request root/hub prefix over cold, so the two comparators coincide at the stratum-success level and jointly bracket the ceiling rather than testing independent mechanisms; both remain strictly below the treatment and differ in their ledgers. This is disclosed, not hidden. The novelty metric is computed from the declared h(n), and cold/retrieval are the strongest bounded policies consistent with no cross-task persistence.

control_sensitivity.reason: Each control can fire and each failure maps to a distinct consequence under the same implementation that scores the experiment: PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA must reach 24/24 (I1) or the bank is unsolvable -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, separating instrument failure from a scientific negative; the low-novelty treatment abort gate plus session-schema guard must hold (I9) or the bank topology/schema is unimplementable -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID; NC-OOS-SCHEMA must refuse 5/5 (I2) or treatment success is a substrate artifact; NC-BUDGET-TRUNCATION must show zero overrun on 6 episodes (I3); M-REPAIR-TRANSIENT must show the arm either repairs (repair_attempts=1, charged) or honestly fails with no hidden retry; PC-EXACT-SESSION-REPLAY must reproduce counters exactly (I5); plus route-leak (I7), counter reconciliation (I4), render equality (I6), determinism (I8) and contamination (I10). The control set is non-vacuous in the strongest sense because the new CC-DEGENERATE calibration control (I11) forces the certificate to demonstrate BOTH outcomes: the frozen predicate must be TRUE on ADB-v6 and FALSE on the same-transport query-answerable sibling, and the sibling's comparators must observationally reach the ceiling. A certificate that returned TRUE unconditionally would fail I11; one that returned FALSE unconditionally would fail the ADB-v6 decision. No remaining control is tautological in the operational sense: the positive control's cost (h+8) is arithmetic-clear of the budget, the null's refusal is a policy decision a greedy fall-through resolver would violate, the repair control injects a transient fault so a repair counter or an honest failure is observable, and the truncation control under-funds episodes so an overrun is observable. Under a byte-faithful render every control passes by construction; the control's non-trivial content is detection of a render that deviates from the declaration plus the certificate's demonstrated sensitivity.

treatment_liveness.reason: T-AMORT-REUSE is a declared deterministic mechanism (open a session, validate the frozen ascending warm-up sequence, walk the bootstrap once, persist the session manifest, record each role's resolved token after its 3-step chain, reuse it on later tasks, refuse out-of-support and non-conforming sessions), not an external Product carrier, so the pre-freeze Product-carrier liveness mandate does not apply. Its liveness is structural and certified arithmetically: the per-task costs (9,7,7,7) fit B(n)={11,15,16,18} at every level, so a faithful implementation resolves all 12 high-novelty and all 12 low-novelty tasks; the low-novelty block is executed FIRST at EXECUTE as a post-freeze abort gate and a liveness failure aborts to MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Ordering robustness: the session schema ALWAYS declares the ascending warm-up sequence ['0.0','0.25','0.5','0.75']; T-AMORT-REUSE validates this before spending and REFUSES (UNKNOWN, no overspend) on any non-conforming session, so a reordered session becomes a refusal rather than a cost blowout and is gate I9 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. The treatment's disjoint counter signature (one boot chain per 4 tasks, /tasks once per session, discovery_calls 0,6,6,6 with zero on reused roles, retrieval_calls 0) demonstrates it is a genuinely different procedure from both comparators. No separate Product carrier is required for this runtime instrument.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: No pre-existing mutable local repository file, task bank, dataset or fixture is consumed by this experiment, so there is nothing to hash into freeze.json.artifact_hashes and the list is empty. Two independent grounds make NOT_APPLICABLE the only valid semantic: (1) the interpretation surface is not an external artifact - the substrate topology, the 24-task ADB-v6 bank and the CC-DEGENERATE calibration bank (both deterministic functions of family x session x level), the role rule h(n)=8n, the fixed 3-step discovery protocol and the query-answerable calibration route, the published budgets, the seed 20261010, the arm policies and the counter predicates are all declared verbatim inside the frozen spec.json/prereg.md (declaration object in prereg.md section 5; predicted certificate in section 6), and the site and arms import no pre-existing Runtime module, so the decision depends only on quantities fixed at freeze; and (2) the DESIGN-stage workflow grants this stage write scope only to spec.json/prereg.md, so authoring a generator/bank file at DESIGN is structurally impossible - the bank is necessarily an EXECUTE deliverable. EXECUTE materialises the generator, harness and reusable substrate post-freeze inside the transaction; those produced files are fingerprinted in result.json.artifacts and recomputed by AUDIT, and gate I6 requires the rendered declaration and recomputed certificate to equal the embedded objects. Had a pre-existing mutable dependency existed it would have been bound; none does, so NOT_APPLICABLE with an empty freeze_artifacts list is correct.
